name: Areas of US law-faculty scholarship
description: Thirteen subject areas, each with fields (level 2), topics (level 3) and, where titles show separable volume, sub-topics (level 4). The areas follow how law professors and law faculties divide the field, tested against which topics the same faculty publish in; the topics come from the titles of every faculty-credited paper on the site. Research approaches (empirical, law & economics, psychology, socio-legal, legal history, critical theory) form a second, cross-cutting axis under "approaches", each with its own subject drill-down.
